briefs.heading: Should the next release remove the old `/v1/export` endpoint?
briefs.why_now: the next release is being prepared; until you answer, the endpoint stays
context: In the last 30 days `/v1/export` had 9 calls from 1 caller.
briefs.recommend: one caller is left, and a removed endpoint can come back

options.choose_if: fewer endpoints to keep working matters more than the one caller
options.downside: the caller breaks if it has not moved

options.leads_to: the endpoint stays to be kept working
options.choose_if: the caller needs time to move
options.downside: one more release carries an endpoint nobody else uses

briefs.not_checked: whether the caller has a plan to move

undo.text: restore the endpoint in a later release
